verdicts.reason: Both crop the racket/ball photo down to an unreadable sliver at the left, wrap 'by submitting to' into a cramped three-line stack and crowd 'Xavier Sport Program' into the right edge. Neither keeps the original's centred stack with divider lines, and the small text is hard to read at this size. B is worse because 'submitting' runs straight into 'Xavier Sport'. A at least leaves a small gap between them.
